named_gap: Evaluation: distinguish historical regression, model comparison, and actual task success before another learner change.

classification.reference_audit: Retrospective: existing scores have been inspected. This adds descriptive readouts and corrects interpretation; it does not change old gates or accept/reject any fitted model.
classification.control_qualification: Prospective no-fit experiment, frozen before any new trial. No learner, controller, or threshold tuning in response to these scores.

platform_readout.scope: saved common forecast windows from platform-v4
platform_readout.quantile_method: nearest rank: sorted[ceil(0.95*N)-1] within each recording
platform_readout.per_window: maximum over the full sampled horizon prefix of Euclidean vector error, separately velocity channels 0:3 and body-rate channels 3:6
platform_readout.aggregate: maximum recording percentile for each predictor and metric
platform_readout.historical_ceiling: the unchanged numbers called task_allowance in platform-v4 are descriptive old-model prefix percentiles, not task-derived requirements; legacy pooled final-step component-RMSE comparisons are retained as historical gates only
platform_readout.inference: Descriptive on previously inspected overlapping windows; no confidence bound, future coverage, or control sufficiency claim.

control_qualification.unchanged: All task, plant, sample timing, initial states, command bounds, tolerances, solver constants and scoring come from the pinned control-v5 and existing solver; no wall deadline or live swaps.

oracle.dynamics: Public Cascade equations from the pinned version/revision, same 400 Hz integration and 20 substeps per 50 ms interval as plant.
oracle.state: Reset from public initial state and initial applied command at declared actuator equilibrium; advance private predictor state only with actually issued commands. Never read live plant internal state.
oracle.mean_map: Exact 15 observed channels mapped by existing states_from_observed: trapezoidal position, projected rotations. Existing generic stage_cost, measure and BoundedShootingSolver unchanged.
oracle.covariance: Retain saved generic mapped covariance identically as a fixed numerical objective offset, because relative-improvement stopping depends on absolute objective. It is not asserted to be oracle uncertainty.
oracle.history: Both new arms hold initial command for first 2 intervals as saved generic does; all intervals still scored.

control_qualification.structured: Load accepted saved belief, replace only horizon/block count with 5/5 and use first 2 interval holds. Retain its own propagation, support penalty and covariance; this remains contextual, not a pure mean-model substitution.
control_qualification.qualification_rule: Oracle must meet the unchanged control-v5 application criterion on both trials: both absolute lateral and altitude error <= 0.5 m for >= 95% of 281 samples at t >= 2 s, no termination. Report separately from historical acceptance and matched-structured RMSE.
control_qualification.limits: Two previously declared seeds on one deterministic simulator; diagnoses this pipeline only. Oracle information exceeds learned model. Failure does not prove no inaccurate model could pass or identify a unique controller defect.

requirements: Reconstruct every plant trajectory from initial state and saved issued commands.
Independently recompute canonical scores and task sample counts.
Check oracle causal predictor state against plant observations at every observed interval.
Reconstruct oracle forecasts from causal state and saved candidate commands at every solve.
Reject altered source plan, input bytes, trial commands, forecasts or summaries even if outer file hashes are changed.

validation: Targeted metric fixtures expose component-RMSE/vector-percentile and pooled/per-recording differences.
Oracle forecast/gradient and causal replay against public Cascade on declared histories.
Common solver policies and fixed covariance checked; no fitter reachable from qualification runner.
Replay and tamper tests; old learner and numerical references unchanged.
stop_rule: Complete this no-fit qualification and report the next named gap. Do not change model/controller or run a search after seeing scores.
